# CholineBio — cholinebio.com

> Choline chloride supplier and technical reference site: feed-grade choline chloride for poultry, swine, aquaculture and companion animals, plus application guides and market price notes.

- [Choline and Inositol](https://cholinebio.com/choline-and-inositol/): The two compounds, compared and combined.
- [Choline Chloride in Poultry Feed](https://cholinebio.com/choline-chloride-in-poultry-feed/): Inclusion rates and formulation notes.
- [Choline Chloride in Dog Food](https://cholinebio.com/choline-chloride-in-dog-food/): Companion-animal applications.
- [Choline Chloride in Cat Food](https://cholinebio.com/choline-chloride-in-cat-food/): Feline formulation notes.
